shortDescription: Adds a virtual service edge node.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: Virtual Service Edge cluster name.

options.name: default_gateway
options.description: The IP address of the default gateway to the internet. Only IPv4 addresses are supported.

options.name: deployment_mode
options.description: Specifies the deployment mode. Select either C(STANDALONE) or C(CLUSTER) if you have the VMware ESXi platform. Otherwise, select only C(STANDALONE).

options.name: establish_support_tunnel_enabled
options.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether or not a support tunnel for Zscaler Support is enabled.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for the Virtual Service Edge node. Used to reference an existing node for update or delete operations.

options.name: in_production
options.description: Represents the Virtual Service Edge instances deployed for production purposes.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: The Virtual Service Edge cluster IP address. Only IPv4 addresses are supported.

options.name: ip_sec_enabled
options.description: A Boolean value that specifies whether to terminate IPSec traffic from the client at selected Virtual Service Edge instances for the Virtual Service Edge cluster.

options.name: load_balancer_ip_address
options.description: The IP address of the load balancer. This field is applicable only when the deployment_mode is set to C(CLUSTER).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Virtual Service Edge node.

options.name: on_demand_support_tunnel_enabled
options.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether or not the On-Demand Support Tunnel is enabled.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: status
options.description: Specifies the status of the Virtual Service Edge cluster. The status is set to ENABLED by default.

options.name: subnet_mask
options.description: The Virtual Service Edge cluster subnet mask (e.g. 255.255.255.0). Only IPv4 addresses are supported.

options.name: type
options.description: The Virtual Service Edge cluster type. For the complete list of supported types refer to the API documentation. U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/service-edges#/virtualZenNodes-post)

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: vzen_sku_type
options.description: The Virtual Service Edge SKU type.
